# Trademark Review

## Overview
This page documents the preliminary trademark clearance and [legal](./legal.md) review results for product names, brands, and co-[marketing](./marketing.md) guidelines involving [Aurora Labs](./aurora-labs.md) and [TeaBuddy](./teabuddy.md).

## Key Details
- **[MeshSync](./meshsync.md)**: Preliminary clearance is okay, with a caveat regarding existing similar mesh [IoT](./iot.md) marks.
- **TeaBuddy**: Preliminary clearance is okay in Class 21 (kitchen gadgets).
- **"[Puck](./teabuddy.md)"**: The standalone term is crowded; it must be used together as "[TeaBuddy Puck](./teabuddy.md)".
- **"SteepSync"**: Must be avoided (already rejected internally by Alex).
- **"[Nova](./aurora-nova-widget-v2.md)"**: Standalone usage conflicts with an existing tech mark; use "[Nova Widget](./nova-widget.md)" instead.
- **Co-marketing Guidelines**: Co-marketing is approved provided that logos are separated by a minimum of 24 pixels.
